description:
4th November 2026, at Vardhman Jagruti Office, Rotary Club of Mulund donated 2,02,000 rupees cheque. Sponsored by Dr. KIRIT BOTHARAJI
The amount of Rs. 2,02,000/- WILL BE distributed for their Chemotherapy, Operation & Radiation treatment at Tata memorial Hospital

Thank you so much KIRTI BOTHARAJI for your generous donation 🙏
